mutations.name: a code artifact stays out of the stage key
kills: resolve stage spec keys on the script, on the doctrine, and on a code artifact only when the run has one

mutations.name: the resolver rows stay out of the doctrine hash
kills: resolve stage spec re-keys when a resolver row changes, so a cached resolve never outlives the table it was chosen by

mutations.name: the chapter links stay out of the resolve key
kills: resolve stage spec keys on the chapter links when the script stage wrote them, so a new companion re-resolves the cards
